profile.org_note: Founder-led private company. A small corporate team in Rehoboth Beach (CEO, COO, CFO, Chief Growth Officer, General Counsel, a corporate Director of Land Acquisition) sits over four division presidents (Delaware, Richmond, Nashville, Boise). Delaware, Richmond and Nashville each have their own land director; Boise does not list one. In Delaware much of the lot supply comes from the Schell family's affiliated developer, Ocean Atlantic Companies (Preston Schell, Tom Tipton), so land and capital decisions run through Chris Schell, CFO Alyssa Pietrobono, Nick Wexler and, on the affiliate side, Preston Schell.
profile.summary: Private, founder-owned semi-custom builder based in Rehoboth Beach, DE, founded in 2003 by Chris Schell; a conventional for-sale builder at the upper end of the price range, with four divisions (Delaware, Richmond, Nashville, Boise since 2024) and about 45 communities on its site. Pro Builder (Dec 2023) put it at 525 closings and about $455M of revenue with 276 staff. Its home-market lots are largely developed by the family's affiliated developer, Ocean Atlantic Companies, which raises outside investor equity; the three newer divisions buy developer lots and contract raw land, and have no public land-banking partner, so they are the natural opening for a land banker.

people.name: Preston Schell
people.title: Chairman and CEO, The Ocean Atlantic Companies
people.source_title: Ocean Atlantic Companies: Our Team (company site)
people.note: Not a Schell Brothers officer. Twin brother of Chris Schell and co-founder (1997) of Ocean Atlantic Companies, the Rehoboth Beach development group that develops many of the Delaware communities Schell Brothers builds in (its lot-development page links Walden and Marlin Chase straight to schellbrothers.com). His Ocean Atlantic bio lists Schell Brothers among the group's companies and says he is managing member of about 50 project LLCs. He is the decision-maker on how Delaware land is capitalised (outside investor equity per project). Phone is Ocean Atlantic's published office line. Title note: The Ocean Atlantic Companies is an affiliate, not Schell Brothers.

people.name: Tom Tipton
people.title: President and COO, The Ocean Atlantic Companies
people.source_title: Ocean Atlantic Companies: Our Team (company site)
people.note: Not a Schell Brothers officer. Runs daily operations of the affiliate that develops lots for Schell Brothers' Delaware communities; joined Ocean Atlantic in June 2015 (bio). Phone is Ocean Atlantic's published office line. Title note: The Ocean Atlantic Companies is an affiliate, not Schell Brothers.

people.name: Greg Tobias
people.title: Principal, The Ocean Atlantic Companies (affiliate)
people.source_title: Ocean Atlantic Companies: Greg Tobias bio (company site)
people.note: He is on Ocean Atlantic's live team page as Principal. His bio there says he is Executive Manager of Ocean Atlantic, managing partner on certain projects, and head of acquisitions and market expansion for Schell Brothers. The bio is undated and reads as several years old, and Schell Brothers' own leadership page does not list him (it lists Nick Wexler for land acquisition and Jon Beaver for growth), so the Schell Brothers role may have been superseded. Tagged Inferred for that reason; worth confirming directly.
